entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I, um, I have a problem with my VeloBand Pulse. I got it for Christmas and it's just... not working. I'm so confused by all this technology.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?
It has to be a technical thing. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I've tried everything the little booklet said. I think it might just be broken.
I see. A device not syncing can certainly be frustrating. And you believe the unit itself is defective?
Yes, I think so. I just don't know what to do. The website was hard to understand and I'm not good with this stuff. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. Let me just pull up your order details and check our policies. One moment please... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered 21 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure what the rules were.
Not at all. I'm looking at our return policy right here, and it says all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You're well within that window.
Oh, really? 90 days? That's a relief. So... you can just take it back?

Absolutely. Since you're reporting it as a defective item and it's well within the 90-day timeframe, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie! I was so worried. That's a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
